report.previous_run_delta: New/direct fit: Mireye launched with 5,000 recurring no-card credits and cited physical-world data that can cover a 155-parcel enrichment pass. Recovered/magnitude: Scaleway plus NVIDIA Inception advertises up to €42,000, but the practical bootstrap path begins at €1,000 and higher tiers require consumption, incorporation, card registration, and dual approval. New: K2 Horizon released a fully open six-model training lifecycle. Emerging watch: Tenable Exchange Inspector is expected later in September but has no published access economics. Yesterday's AWS, AREX, Daybreak, Astra, and PAIR signals were unchanged and not recycled.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH LAUNCH; PRIMARY PRICING VERIFIED
signals.changed: Mireye launched publicly with a US physical-world API and MCP server returning cited, timestamped, confidence-scored fields, typed absence, geocoding, parcel lookup, proximity calculations, and field requests.
signals.free_value: 5,000 credits every month, no card, 20 requests/minute, no overage billing, and one field request at signup. Geocoding costs 1 credit; fields cost 1 per field/location; natural-language Ask costs 10; parcel lookup costs 300.
signals.approximate_value: Enough for about 238 addresses with geocoding plus 20 fields, or all 155 existing candidate parcels for about 3,255 credits if parcel lookup is unnecessary.
signals.fit: Directly applicable to the Bemidji/Beltrami property-intelligence corpus and ICE because each result carries source, fetched timestamp, confidence, and ok/absent/failed state.
signals.catch: US catalog only; source freshness varies; full parcel/owner lookup would exhaust the free tier quickly; county-specific accuracy remains untested.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED PROGRAM SURFACE; HEADLINE VALUE HEAVILY CONDITIONAL
signals.changed: Recovered a partner-layer cloud program offering up to €42,000 for startups that qualify for both NVIDIA Inception and Scaleway Startup Program membership.
signals.free_value: The ordinary path begins with a one-time €1,000 Founders voucher for 12 months; Early Stage offers up to €9,000 over six months; Growth offers up to €36,000 over twelve months; qualifying Inception members are advertised up to €42,000.
signals.approximate_value: €1,000 plausibly accessible first-stage value; €9,000–€42,000 conditional on approval, product maturity, membership, and consumption.
signals.fit: Scaleway requires a company under five years old, fewer than 50 employees, and no previous Scaleway client relationship. NVIDIA Inception separately requires an incorporated product company, working site, and developer.
signals.catch: A valid card and €1 authorization are required to order resources. Progression beyond Founders expects at least €500/month Early Stage or €1,500/month Growth consumption. Overages are billable and the full headline is not bootstrap-immediate.

signals.classification: CONFIRMED FRESH OPEN RELEASE; PERFORMANCE PUBLISHER-REPORTED
signals.changed: IFM released six K2 Horizon models from 0.9B to 375B-A23B with final weights, intermediate checkpoints, training code, data or recipes, configurations, logs, evaluation results, and agentic post-training artifacts.
signals.free_value: Apache-2.0 model weights and code, with dataset-specific licenses; day-zero support for Ollama, vLLM, and SGLang.
signals.approximate_value: The 0.9B and quantized 3.7B models provide locally testable agent/tool-use capability without per-token API charges; the larger models require hardware or cloud credits.
signals.fit: The small models may run on the current 16GB EliteBook for bounded local classification, extraction, and routing; the open training history is unusually useful for ICE-style capability-delta research.
signals.catch: CPU-only performance may be slow, published benchmarks require independent validation, and this release supplies weights rather than free hosted inference.

omissions_errors: Mireye coverage and field freshness for Beltrami County were not independently tested; the 155-parcel capacity estimate assumes one geocode plus 20 fields per parcel and excludes 300-credit parcel lookups.
Scaleway does not guarantee a particular award; the €42,000 figure is an up-to amount for startups satisfying both NVIDIA Inception and Scaleway requirements.
Scaleway progression beyond the €1,000 Founders voucher requires meaningful monthly consumption and a valid payment card; the user's incorporation status is not known.
K2 Horizon performance claims are publisher-reported and were not independently benchmarked in this run; no free hosted inference endpoint was verified.
Tenable Exchange Inspector was excluded as a headline signal because availability is expected later in September and pricing/access terms are not yet published.
